description:
Commits the build identity record of the story's benchmark arms, the digests every campaign checks before it starts.

## Background

The gf2 arms of the LDPC batch decoder and the AFF3CT arms [Cassagne2019] are built or catalogued under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms/` and `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/survey/arms.json`. A campaign refuses an arm whose digest differs from the recorded build identity.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `dev/bench_results/ed3d490e/preparation/build-identity.json` gives each arm's executable digest, toolchain, flags and input identities, written by a committed recorder from the commands the recording run executes.
- [hard] REQ-02: The recorder refuses an arm that `arms.json` names and the build does not produce, and a second run over an unchanged build reproduces the record.

## Notes

Source references: [Cassagne2019].
title: Record the build identity of the benchmark arms
